newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, firm cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, firm cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed strongly higher on active exports and firm cash markets, traders said.
"The export sales plus the Costa Rican tender this week plus the buying by Term Commodities supported it," a trader said.
Traders salso said the cash market remained firm and farmer selling was sporadic at best. Rice futures volume was estimated at 800 contracts, up from 214 Thursday.
Rice closed 14 to 24 cents per cwt higher, with November up 14 at $10.41.
